bundle.shortDescription: Unofficial WhatsApp Web desktop client for Linux
bundle.longDescription: WaLinux is an unofficial, lightweight WhatsApp Web desktop client built with Tauri and Rust. It adds Linux desktop notifications, a system tray, window state persistence, and categorized downloads.
